column1: Iron ore, the terms of trade and the Australian dollar
column3: Iron ore is one of Australia’s biggest exports, so firm export prices tend to lift the terms of trade and, over time, the Australian dollar. The US dollar rides along as context: a falling Australian dollar is often mostly a rising US dollar. — iron ore: rising · the terms of trade: falling · the Australian dollar: falling · the US dollar: rising
